findings: Research enhancement metric improved from 0 to 6/6; full guard is 35 passing tests.
A rank-two m=1<->3 parent-channel operator gives an N=7 Coulomb integrated bright/dark ratio of 616 and lowest-pole ratio of 1443.
The lowest N=7 L=2 pole carries 77.4% of the bright parent-channel weight.
Sparse exact highest-weight projection removes the dense null-space basis and reaches N=9.
The N=9 variational gap is 0.1305092442; its 100000-sample estimate is 0.1305092418+/-6.64e-9.
The method still enumerates fixed-M Fock sectors and the chirality operator is not the full finite-sphere Coulomb metric derivative.
